description: Stable PolkaswapAgent error catalog for automation runners. Branch on error.code, not message text.

AGENT_API_UNAVAILABLE.action: Wait for polkaswap-agent-ready or reload the app before calling the API.

ASSET_AMBIGUOUS.action: Resolve the asset by address instead of symbol.

ASSET_NOT_FOUND.action: Search assets or provide a known asset address.

INVALID_AMOUNT.action: Rebuild the request with a positive decimal string amount.

INVALID_AGENT_STATE.action: Import only v1 state or clear local agent state before retrying.

INVALID_ASSET_REF.action: Pass either { address } or an unambiguous { symbol }.

INVALID_CLIENT_ORDER_ID.action: Provide a non-empty stable clientOrderId for execution retries.

INVALID_DEX_ID.action: Use dexId "best" or a valid numeric DEX id.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.action: Call transactionStatus or recoverTransaction for the existing clientOrderId; do not reuse it for a different intent.

INTENT_MISMATCH.action: Re-run the matching prepare* method and execute with the new intentId.

INVALID_LIQUIDITY_SOURCE.action: Use a liquidity source accepted by the current app capabilities.

INVALID_POOL_PAIR.action: Use two different assets that can form a pool pair.

INVALID_RECIPIENT.action: Validate the destination address before preparing the transfer.

INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_SOURCE.action: Use source local, indexer, or all.

INVALID_TRANSACTION_ID.action: Provide id, txId, clientOrderId, or intentId for transaction lookup.

INVALID_WALLET_SOURCE.action: Refresh wallets and select a valid wallet source.

NODE_NOT_READY.action: Call ready({ requireNode: true }) again after reconnecting, reloading, or switching endpoint.

PATH_UNAVAILABLE.action: Try a different pair, amount, DEX, or liquidity source.

POOL_UNAVAILABLE.action: Call poolInfo and use an existing pool or explicitly opt into pool creation where supported.

QUOTE_TIMEOUT.action: Retry with a longer quoteTimeoutMs or choose a simpler route.

SIGNING_CANCELLED.action: Treat as cancellation and call recoverTransaction before retrying.

WALLET_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND.action: Refresh wallet accounts and choose an available address.

WALLET_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED.action: Connect a wallet account before calling wallet-only helpers.

WALLET_NOT_CONNECTED.action: Connect/select a wallet and call ready({ requireWallet: true }).

WALLET_NOT_FOUND.action: Install, unlock, or choose an available injected wallet provider.
